apps.localizedDescription:
Features:

• Setup assistant on first launch: one simple question per screen with big tappable tiles: brewer (pour-over or espresso machine like Cafelat Robot, Flair 58, Decent DE1, La Marzocco, Gaggia) → connect the espresso machine (GaggiMate, Decent DE1 or La Marzocco; only if you picked one) → filter papers (the ones that fit your brewer come first; skipped for espresso only) → grinder + your usual setting → beans → scale. The Gear tab lists espresso machines apart from pour-over brewers. Every step can be skipped. "Skip, just use the scale" goes straight to Quick weigh. Run it again any time from Gear → Setup assistant. If you skipped it, the Brew tab shows a small reminder card.

versions.localizedDescription:
• A knock on the scale no longer spoils a brew: short spikes are removed even when the scale sends several readings of them, so the final weight, the pour analysis ("overpoured") and the flow chart ignore them.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your Bluetooth coffee scale to read the weight live while you brew.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: BrewLog uses the camera to photograph your coffee bag and read the details from its label. The photo stays on this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BrewLog connects to your espresso machine (GaggiMate) in your Wi-Fi to record pressure and temperature and to start shots.
